units.id: mission:Incipias: Help The Stranded 2|	"What an odd-reasonable question." It's glow turns into a swirl of purple and green. "We could ask the same in return - what is it like to live on hard rock? But we understand its reasoning-origin. So let me tell you of the cloud-halls of our home-sky.
